title: Akousma
description: Opt-in spec 1.8: native evidence and spectral derivatives; explicit consumer admission required.

subject.description: Category-level object of a listening or attempted listening when no audio asset exists. Never contains withheld content.

capture_conditions.description: Conditions of capture that travel with the sound: who recorded whom, where, under what agreement.

pipeline_effects.description: Which of the seven technological effects (after Chion) the sound has passed through, oldest first.

relations.description: Typed curatorial links between records. Parents are causal genealogy; relations are kinship: variants, responses, recurrences, series.

akouo.agent-native.description: Full offline and reference validation supplied by the host. Unavailable validator means unvalidated evidence.

summary.description: One-line human-readable account of the sound for skimming and search; the record stays the source of truth.

location.description: Where the sound was heard (v1.2). Optional and consent-scoped: producers attach it only when the listener granted it; navigators may add or correct it afterwards. Stripped from open-research exports.

label.description: Human place name that travels with the sound.

capture.description: How the listening was triggered (v1.2): temporal direction relative to the trigger and the window length. Device and format detail stay in provenance/audio.

direction.description: past = the seconds already in the ring buffer when the trigger fired; future = the seconds recorded after it; live = an open-ended or manual session.

trigger.description: What initiated the listen: hotkey, remote-ear, mcp, dashboard, watcher, schedule…

covenant.description: Under which ethics this was listened (v1.3). The listening covenant's identity plus honest absence: what was withheld under its rules, counted and attributed, never described. The covenant's full text stays with its author — records carry identity and hash, so exports stay safe by construction.

id.description: The covenant's stable slug, optionally versioned: 'river-covenant/2'.

contract.description: The AKOÚŌ contract the covenant was parsed under, e.g. 'akouo/v0.7'.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the covenant's source text: identity without content.

extends.description: The covenant's declared lineage (manifestos, community protocols, parent covenants).

rules_applied.description: The covenant rules that acted on this hearing, as normalized rule lines.

withheld.description: Honest absence: what was withheld, named at category level and attributed to its rule.

commitments.description: How many non-executable commitments the covenant carries.

auditum.description: The addressable listening record around this sound, listening-only account, or pre-capture decision (v1.6). 'Tokenized' means structured, attributable, versioned, and referenceable; it does not mean a financial token.

listenings.description: Attributable accounts; machine reports do not establish embodied hearing.

disagreements.description: Differences between attributable listenings. Consumers preserve positions and must not manufacture consensus; a resolved disagreement requires a non-empty attributable resolution note.

actions.description: Action proposals and receipts. Perceptual or technical capability is not authority.

route_decisions.description: Addressable gate outcomes. Refusal or withholding is a complete record, not a missing listening.

revision.description: A re-listening is a new, attributable revision. The earlier auditum remains intact.

matterContext.description: Application-owned MASA 0.2.0 label mapping. Source modality, structured representation, temporal evidence domain and listening access are independent; no label asserts audibility or sensor capability.
